## Changes

### New
- Desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux, with the same library, reader, downloads and extensions as on Android. Mihon extensions stay Android only. Linux has no in-app WebView yet: pages open in your browser, and sources that need a WebView do not load there.
- Google Drive sync on desktop: sign in in your browser.
- Desktop apps update themselves from new releases, like the Android app.
- Wide screens (tablets in landscape, desktop windows) show a comic's details beside its chapter list.
- The reader keeps pages fitted to width at most 800 wide, centred, on wide screens.
- Reader keyboard keys: arrows, space and Page Up / Page Down move through the pages, Escape leaves.
- Right click does what a long press does (select chapters, save a page, copy a title), and mice can drag lists to scroll and refresh.
- On desktop, saving a page asks where to save it.
- New app icon on iOS and desktop.
